# BetterBulakan

> Community-powered portal of the Municipality of Bulakan, Bulacan.

BetterBulakan is a volunteer-run, open-source portal for the Municipality of Bulakan, Bulacan (Region III). It is not an official government website; the official LGU site is https://elgu-bulacan-bulacan-news.e.gov.ph/home.

Source code: https://github.com/betterbulakan/betterbulakan

## Elected Officials

- Mayor: Vergel C. Meneses
